posts.title: Chapter 45 discussion!
content: Thank you for the amazing chapter! Seems like it's finally happening! Kat has been sold. Now I only wonder if she will go to Leo directly or (more likely in my opinion) go to a different Noble first and later be gifted to him. Can't wait to find out!

comments.content: It won't be long now! I can't wait to hear if you like the way I handle the ending (and also be a little scared that you won't like it... 😅)
Oh, is it almost over?

Yes, book 1 is coming to a close soon, however the story itself is nowhere near over! I'm not entirely sure how long the whole story could become, but there will be a second book. I am looking to go back and implement the feedback I have gotten on this book before continuing though :D So there will be a little break, but don't worry, I will post all the info along with the final chapter of book 1.

posts.title: Am I the only one who doesn't trust Leopold?
content: Okay, I know Leo is supposed to be one of the main characters, but am I seriously the only one getting major red flags from this guy?? 😂 Like sure, he has helped Kat a few times, but he also seems to treat everything like some elaborate game. And the fact that he can literally read people's minds makes it so much worse!

I honestly can't tell if he actually cares about Katharina or if he's just fascinated by the fact that he can't understand her thoughts. Either way, I'm really curious where their relationship is going. What do you guys think?

comments.content: THANK YOU!! Everyone seems to love him but I would be absolutely terrified of that man. The power imbalance is insane.
Look I'm not saying he's a good person, I'm just saying he's an INTERESTING person 👀

I love reading all your theories! :D Without spoiling anything, I will say that I never intended for Leopold to be an entirely good or bad person. He has his own motivations, and whether those align with Katharina's is another question entirely. Really excited for you guys to see what happens next!

posts.title: Something doesn't add up about Kat's aura...
content: So I've been thinking about this since the mountain chapters. We know that Kat has barely any aura of her own, but she keeps managing to do things that shouldn't really be possible for someone at her level.

Remember when Leo cleared the path through the mountains? What if Kat isn't actually weak, but just doesn't understand how to use her abilities yet? Or maybe being from Earth has something to do with it?
I might be completely overthinking this lol, but I feel like the author is setting something up here.

comments.content: I thought the same thing!! Especially with how she approaches aura almost like a science experiment. Maybe everyone else is just too stuck in their traditional way of thinking?
My theory is that she can somehow borrow aura from other people. Would explain a LOT actually.
WAIT that actually makes so much sense. Imagine if she figures out how to use Leopold's aura against him 😂

Ohhh I love seeing you guys trying to figure out the aura system! Some very interesting theories in here 👀 I obviously can't confirm or deny anything, but I can say that Kat's unusual approach to aura is definitely intentional. Keep theorizing! :D

posts.title: Does anyone else really want to visit Lysies?
content: Okay, ignoring the slavery, political scheming and general danger for a moment...
I would LOVE to walk around the city of Lysies. The descriptions of the buildings, the palace, and the whole aura-based society make me wish we could actually visit.
What would you guys do first if you somehow ended up in Auropia? Personally, I'd find a market and spend the entire day looking at aura stones. Preferably without accidentally offending a noble.

comments.content: I'd immediately try to figure out if I could use aura. Which would probably end very badly.
I'd be on the first ship to Kalaria. The islands sound amazing, and I feel like I'd have a better chance of surviving there 😂
I just want to see someone use a rune stone in everyday life. Imagine having magical household appliances!

posts.title: What would your aura ability be?
content: Fun question because I have absolutely no motivation to do anything productive today.
If you lived in the world of Kat & Leo and could develop ONE aura ability, what would you want it to be?
It doesn't have to be something we've seen in the story. Just something that makes sense with the aura system.
I'd personally want to control temperature. Imagine never being too hot or cold again. Forget fighting, I just want to be comfortable.

comments.content: Teleportation. I refuse to spend another minute on public transport.
Being able to detect lies would be incredibly useful. Although in Lysies that might also get me killed.
Mind reading. For completely normal and not at all suspicious reasons.
I would like to point out that you have already seen what happens when someone with questionable morals gets that ability 😂

posts.title: Hot take: Leopold owning Katharina is NOT romantic. Why are we celebrating this??
content: Okay, I KNOW I'm probably going to get absolutely destroyed for this, but I need to say it.

Why is everyone acting like Katharina ending up with Leopold is some kind of happy ending? HE LITERALLY OWNS HER. I don't care how charming he is or how many times he's helped her. She has absolutely no power in that relationship.
And before someone says 'but he's better than the other nobles' — THAT IS SUCH A LOW BAR.
I love this story, genuinely. But sometimes I read the comments and wonder if we're even reading the same book. Am I missing something??

comments.content: Counterargument: he's hot.
I AM BEGGING YOU TO HAVE HIGHER STANDARDS 😭
THANK YOU. Finally someone said it. I love Leopold as a CHARACTER, but the way people talk about him like he's some misunderstood sweetheart is genuinely baffling.
I feel slightly attacked as someone who has drawn him approximately 500 times 😂 But seriously, I think there's a difference between liking a fictional character and approving of their actions.
I actually think that's the entire point of their dynamic? Katharina can't trust him, but she also can't really afford NOT to. It's uncomfortable because it's supposed to be uncomfortable.

Sorry but I disagree. He's repeatedly shown that he cares about what happens to her. He could have treated her so much worse, and he hasn't. People are acting like he's personally responsible for inventing slavery.
HE DOESN'T HAVE TO INVENT SLAVERY TO BENEFIT FROM IT. That's literally my point.
Okay but what exactly do you expect him to do? Free her immediately and let her get captured by someone worse? He's operating within the society he was born into.
I think both of you have a point. Keeping her close might genuinely be the safest option available right now, but that doesn't make the situation good or fair.

Can we also discuss how people keep assuming Katharina will fall in love with him? She's been trying to SURVIVE this entire time. A man being interested in her doesn't automatically make it a romance.
I would like to clarify that my original argument was not intended to be examined this closely.
I'm just sitting here eating popcorn watching everyone fight over a man who would probably find this entire argument hilarious.
The worst part is that Leo would absolutely read all our thoughts and then deliberately say whatever would make the argument worse.

I don't even ship them romantically. I just think they're fascinating together. Two people who approach the world completely differently, neither of whom fully understands the other. That's what keeps me reading.

I feel like people are deliberately interpreting everything he does in the worst possible way. He has shown genuine curiosity and concern for her, and I don't think that's meaningless just because of his position.
Curiosity is not the same thing as compassion. You can be fascinated by someone and still treat them terribly.

Well, this certainly became a discussion! 😅 I love seeing everyone engage with the characters so passionately. I don't want to settle the debate, because I think it's interesting that readers interpret Leopold's actions so differently. All I'll say is that you don't have to agree with a character's decisions to enjoy their story. And please remember to be kind to each other! ❤️
THE AUTHOR HAS ENTERED THE CHAT. EVERYONE ACT NORMAL.

For the record, I absolutely love how complicated Leopold is. That's WHY I made this post. I just want Kat to get some actual choices for once 😭 Anyway, thanks for all the responses. Even the ones I strongly disagree with. Except the 'he's hot' argument. I'm still processing that one.
